response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack experience and strong engineering fundamentals, the candidate lacks demonstrable production experience with GenAI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph — all core requirements for the role. Their AI-related work is limited to vague 'agent infrastructure' contributions without evidence of deploying GenAI solutions at scale or leading technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with TypeScript/Node.js and cloud tools (AWS CDK)
Proven experience building and open-sourcing complex systems (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Demonstrated leadership in mentoring and technical workshops
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions as required
Missing direct experience with vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization techniques
No clear track record of leading customer-facing technical discovery or enterprise AI deployments
